text.tspan: When Code Gets Cheap, What Do You Sell?

g.desc: For bespoke software, paying on a verified result is the rare, novel end, not yet the norm
Not something you buy: a lifecycle rewrite where agents construct and humans design what they operate within
Boolean pass/fail gives way to scoring the fraction of runs that satisfy intent
Stays scarce: deciding what to build and proving it was built right; only the codifiable parts drift right
For bespoke software, paying on a verified result is the rare, novel end, not yet the norm
